acceptance_criteria: Every Messenger implementation accepts SendOptions and forwards a trusted caller token to the outbound identity guard.
Health and other system callers bypass the cold-target floor through the iMessage, Signal, Twilio, and Baileys connection implementations.
Calls without a trusted caller token retain agent identity and cannot obtain the system-caller exemption.
An OutboundIdentityError raised before any provider call is recorded as failed_permanent rather than maybe_sent.
Focused tests prove caller propagation, default-agent behavior, zero provider calls on guard rejection, and correct durable disposition for every transport bridge.
blast_radius: Trusted health and infrastructure sends, cold-target enforcement, iMessage, Signal, SMS, durable outbound disposition, recovery ambiguity, and operator diagnostics.

Exact-main SendOptions and sendTracked carry caller provenance, and Baileys consumes it, but the iMessage, Signal, and Twilio bridge methods accept only two arguments and hard-code caller agent. Their synchronous identity rejection occurs before adapter sendText, while sendTracked catches every rejection and records maybe_sent. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if every bridge consumed SendOptions.caller and a pre-provider identity rejection settled failed_permanent. Exact-main source shows neither. Cross-transport caller and durable-disposition fault injection remains an implementation-time obligation.
impact: Trusted infrastructure sends can be rejected as ordinary agent sends on non-Baileys transports, and the deterministic pre-provider rejection is then promoted into false delivery ambiguity.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2556 and remote main immediately before integration; reject any changed identity, labels, timestamp, URL, or body hash.

Keep trusted caller construction limited to existing infrastructure call sites; do not expose caller selection through untrusted input.
Add RED and GREEN tests for all four bridge implementations, default-agent behavior, guard rejection before provider invocation, and failed_permanent versus maybe_sent disposition.
Re-scan all open pull requests and establish one implementation owner before mutation.
Coordinate raw error persistence and diagnostics with issue #2517 and ambiguous-send work in issues #2553 and #2555.
